protocol.best_epoch_rule: minimum validation ADE, earliest epoch on exact tie; report paired FDE of that epoch
protocol.capacity_rule: same d64; independently widen only residual delta intermediate to395/230, near H3 params
protocol.convergence_rule: relative train loss decrease in final five epochs < 2%; diagnostic only, not proof of optimum
protocol.groups: original Stage2.5 groups plus full8/partial intersections; no future-dependent grouping
protocol.initialization: full H3 A-R template, truncate modules without RNG draws; common parameters identical per seed
protocol.interpretation: paired three seed development differences, no significance/generalization claim; independent training vs inference separated
protocol.metrics: K1 ADE/FDE meters; fixed final-horizon FDE mask
protocol.negative_controls: fixed-checkpoint inference only; local max-change, scene random/max-change, in/out degree swaps, indirect cut and matched random deletion
protocol.path_statistics: history-only timed walks at cutoff; H2 3-distinct nodes and unique intermediaries per endpoint pair; H3 backtracks/end returns
protocol.relation_intervention_legality: all: continuous same-scene no-self no-duplicate history endpoints; nonlocal controls explicitly relax4m radius
protocol.time_control: strict old lower state vs old lower state + current received lower message; q1 and carry unchanged
